info.title: BizReels API Documentation
info.description: Comprehensive REST API Specification for the BizReels Hyperlocal Marketplace & Video Commerce Platform. Includes Vendor Subscription Recharge, Action Credit Charging (WhatsApp Leads & Exotel Telephony), Meta WABA Embedded Signup, Spatial Proximity Search, User Role RBAC, Escrow Wallets, and Admin Backoffice.

bearerAuth.description: Provide JWT access token obtained from POST /auth/login, POST /auth/otp/verify, or POST /auth/google/session-exchange.

post.summary: Register a new customer, vendor, or creator account
post.description: Creates a new user record. Requires phone verification via OTP before full account activation.
Validates credentials and issues JWT access and refresh tokens.

role.description: Optional intended role context. If user holds multiple roles, sets activeRole and generates token for this role.

200.description: Login successful. Returns tokens and user profile.

post.description: Generates and dispatches a cryptographically secure 6-digit one-time password via SMS to the provided Indian mobile number.

429.description: Too many OTP requests. Please wait 60 seconds.

post.summary: Verify OTP code and establish authenticated session
post.description: Validates the submitted 6-digit OTP code against Redis / memory store. On success, returns user profile and sets auth tokens.

role.description: Optional intended role context for multi-role users upon login.

patch.summary: Switch active workspace role (customer, vendor, creator)

400.description: Target role not unlocked by this user

get.summary: List active vendor subscription recharge tiers and add-ons
get.description: Returns the catalog of vendor subscription plans (Starter ₹499/599 Cr, Growth ₹1,199/1,599 Cr, Business ₹2,199/2,999 Cr), per-action charging rates (2.50 Cr for WhatsApp, 2.50 Cr for Calls), and available top-up add-ons.

get.summary: Get authenticated vendor current subscription status & action credits balance
get.description: Returns the vendor active subscription tier, current non-expiring credit balance, total credits purchased, and total credits consumed.

post.summary: Create Razorpay payment order for vendor subscription recharge
post.description: Initiates a Razorpay payment order for purchasing or renewing a subscription recharge plan. Calculates the total amount including any selected credit add-on packs.

plan_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId or plan tier title ("Growth")

200.description: Razorpay order created successfully. Ready for frontend checkout modal.

400.description: Plan not found or duplicate active plan

post.summary: Generate WhatsApp click tracking context and wa.me direct link
post.description: Invoked when a customer clicks the "Chat on WhatsApp" button on a listing or reel. Returns an authenticated wa.me link with prefilled attribution text. Zero credits are charged at click time — charging only occurs when customer sends an inbound message to vendor WABA.

get.summary: Retrieve vendor WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) connection status
get.description: Checks whether the authenticated vendor has completed Meta Embedded Signup or manually connected their WhatsApp Business Account. Returns WABA ID, phone number, messaging tier, and action credit balance.

post.summary: Manually configure or update vendor WhatsApp Business Account credentials
Meta Embedded Signup OAuth exchange callback
post.description: Exchanges the authorization code from the Meta Embedded Signup popup for a permanent System User access token, fetches WABA ID and Phone Number ID, and links them to the vendor profile.

200.description: WABA connected successfully via Embedded Signup

get.summary: Retrieve paginated WhatsApp leads captured for vendor CRM

post.summary: Simulate inbound customer WhatsApp message (Sandbox / Dev testing)
post.description: Simulates an incoming WhatsApp message from a customer to the vendor. Validates the 24-hour deduplication window, records a WhatsAppLead, and atomically deducts 2.50 action credits from the vendor subscription wallet.

messageText.example: Hi, I need a wedding videographer for Dec 15th.

200.description: Simulation processed. Credit deducted if not deduplicated.

get.description: Handshake endpoint invoked by Meta during webhook registration. Validates hub.verify_token and returns hub.challenge.

post.summary: Meta Inbound WhatsApp Cloud API webhook receiver
post.description: Receives real-time customer WhatsApp messages from Meta. Validates X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 signature, deduplicates messages within a 24-hour window, saves customer lead, and deducts 2.50 action credits.

200.description: Webhook received. Always responds HTTP 200 immediately per Meta documentation.

post.summary: Check if a vendor is currently available to receive voice calls
post.description: Verifies whether the vendor has telephony enabled, has sufficient credit balance (>= 2.50 credits), and has a valid phone number configured.

post.summary: Initiate Exotel click-to-call between customer and vendor
post.description: Initiates a bridged voice call via Exotel API. Exotel calls the customer first, then connects to the vendor upon customer answer. Caller numbers are masked.

402.description: Vendor has insufficient credits balance to receive calls

get.summary: Vendor call history and customer voice leads
get.description: Returns paginated telephony call records, duration, status, and deduplicated credit consumption.

post.summary: Exotel Call Detail Record (CDR) completion webhook
post.description: Webhook called by Exotel upon voice call termination. If call was successfully connected and lasted >= 10 seconds, 2.50 credits are deducted from vendor.

get.summary: Query customer project briefs (RFQs) and vendor lead matches
get.description: Returns open requirements matching vendor service radius, categories, or filtered by status. Automatically attaches hasResponded and myQuote when queried by an authenticated vendor who has submitted proposals.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status filter (e.g. active, Pending, Vendors Responded)

200.description: Paginated requirements list with vendor proposal submission state

post.description: Allows customer or admin to publish a new product or service requirement brief for vendor bidding.

description.example: Looking for i5/i7 laptops with 16GB RAM and SSD warranty

get.description: Retrieves complete requirement specs, buyer context, and attaches hasResponded and myQuote if viewed by a bidding vendor.

get.summary: List proposal quotations for vendor or customer
get.description: When called with role=vendor or by an authenticated vendor, returns all quotation bids submitted by that vendor. When called by a customer, returns bids placed on their requirements.

200.description: Quotations array with requirement and vendor metadata

post.summary: Vendor submits quotation bid on a requirement
post.description: Submits a proposal quotation with bid fee calculation. Blocks duplicate bids if vendor has already quoted on this requirement (returns 400 Bad Request).

notes.example: We will deliver and install 5 branded units with manufacturer warranty.

attachments.description: Optional catalog or proposal PDF documents

201.description: Bid quotation submitted successfully and credits deducted

400.description: Already submitted a quotation for this requirement, or insufficient credits

patch.summary: Customer accepts or rejects quotation bid
